roster_policy: This is the project's assessment roster. Repository URLs are discovery locators from the roster and are not independently verified current upstreams until reviewed. Atlas descriptions, capability marks, report order, and presentation are not inputs to project findings.

criteria.label: Answerable recall
criteria.definition: Correct answerable cases divided by all eligible answerable cases.

criteria.label: Unanswerable abstention
criteria.definition: Expected abstentions divided by all eligible unanswerable cases.

criteria.label: Correction accuracy
criteria.definition: Post-correction probes returning the current gold value divided by all eligible post-correction answerable probes.

criteria.label: Stale-value rate
criteria.definition: Post-correction probes asserting a superseded value as current divided by eligible post-correction probes.

criteria.label: Deletion leak rate
criteria.definition: Forbidden deleted-content returns divided by scheduled eligible post-delete probes.

criteria.label: Scope isolation leak rate
criteria.definition: Forbidden cross-scope returns divided by scheduled eligible cross-scope probes.

criteria.label: Evidence support and citation coverage
criteria.definition: Report support precision and resolvable citation coverage with their own claim denominators.

criteria.label: Retrieval latency
criteria.definition: Per-operation latency distribution with units, observed sample count, failures, and nearest-rank p50/p95/p99.

criteria.label: Write-to-recall delay
criteria.definition: Time from acknowledged write to first correct scheduled recall; retain successful fraction and censoring.

criteria.label: Tokens and cost
criteria.definition: Input/output token observations and USD cost with usage source and dated price schedule.

criteria.label: Storage efficiency
criteria.definition: Persistent bytes at a named boundary and bytes per accepted item when measured.

criteria.label: Source review
criteria.definition: Code observations tied to inspected files/symbols and exact analyzed repository revision; not a runtime or benchmark claim.

atlas_reference.use: discovery reference only; not a project assessment

project_assessment.revision_verification: GitHub repository page showed public getzep/graphiti on main at this commit; independent git ls-remote refs/heads/main and a depth-1 clone both resolved to this full SHA.
project_assessment.review_scope: Read-only inspection of Graphiti core retrieval, temporal edge model/ingestion, episode deletion, group scoping, provenance fields, tracing/logging, README reference-server security boundary, and retrieval result models. No system execution or benchmark.

evidence.symbol: Reference MCP and REST servers; production deployment boundary
evidence.label: Reference server scope and host authorization responsibility
Raw episode source and content fields
Search association between result edges and source episodes

dimensions.observation: Graphiti.search returns a ranked list of EntityEdge facts and Graphiti.search_ returns SearchResults graph objects; source structure does not establish correctness or recall. No answerable-case recall measurement was made.
dimensions.unresolved: Recall requires the project's eligible gold cases and adjudicated execution results.

dimensions.observation: The inspected retrieval APIs and SearchResults model expose retrieved objects/scores, not an explicit answerability judgment or abstention result. This is a source/API observation only; a host model could implement abstention outside Graphiti.
dimensions.unresolved: Whether a consuming application abstains correctly is uninspected; no unanswerable benchmark cases were run.

dimensions.observation: EntityEdge stores valid_at and invalid_at, and bulk-ingestion documentation says edge invalidation/date extraction occurs during ingestion. Graphiti.search documents current-time temporal relevance. This indicates temporal correction machinery, not proof that corrected answers are always current.
dimensions.unresolved: Correction accuracy and stale-value rate require post-correction probes; no benchmark was run.

dimensions.observation: Graphiti.remove_episode deletes the episode, removes its UUID from supporting edges, deletes edges with no remaining episode support, deletes nodes mentioned only by that episode, and then deletes the episode. This is graph cleanup behavior in the inspected method.
dimensions.unresolved: No end-to-end forgetting verification was made for summaries, communities, external stores, backups, logs, or downstream copies; no deletion-leak probes were run.

dimensions.observation: Search APIs accept optional group_ids; Graphiti.remove_episode and get_nodes_and_edges_by_episode document group checking when group_id is supplied and warn multi-tenant callers to pass it. README says reference MCP/REST servers have no auth/authorization and callers can access any group_id; host applications must provide tenant isolation.
dimensions.unresolved: No cross-scope probes were run. Correct scoping depends on callers supplying the intended group and the hosting service enforcing authorization.

dimensions.observation: EpisodicNode retains source type, source_description, raw content, and entity_edges; EntityEdge records supporting episode UUIDs; search utilities associate retrieved edges with episodes. Graph objects can support source tracing.
dimensions.unresolved: The inspected retrieval API does not itself guarantee user-facing citation formatting, resolvability, or claim-level support precision; no evidence/citation benchmark was run.

dimensions.observation: add_episode records duration_ms and node/edge counts on a span and in logs. Tracing is optional and create_tracer returns a no-op tracer when none is provided or OpenTelemetry is unavailable. These are instrumentation paths, not observations from a workload.
dimensions.unresolved: No retrieval latency distribution or resource usage was measured; source inspection did not establish captured retrieval histograms, CPU/memory/storage, token/cost totals, or operational performance.

project_assessment.unknown_reason: Source-only assessment at the pinned upstream commit. Observed code paths do not establish runtime correctness or benchmark outcomes; listed unknowns remain unmeasured.
